description: This file declares internal API function prototypes for the Slap Bmc2 Application Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane implementation. It includes function prototypes for obtaining internal components and managing lock states.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoGetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP GOA Interface associated with the application object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoGetOlmContainer
methods.description: Obtains the OLM container related to the application object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoReset
methods.description: Resets the application object to its initial state.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock to synchronize access to the application object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoUnlock
methods.description: Releases the previously acquired lock on the application object.
